mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 65 degrees at the Verona Public Library under overcast skies. The ISS will pass overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. Tonight the temperature will dip to a low of 60 degrees, and rain is in the forecast.

In city news, chip seal road maintenance begins on September 23 across several areas, including Cross Country Road and the Liberty Business Park. Additionally, the Plan Commission is reviewing several new development projects at their meeting on October 5.

There is plenty to do this weekend! Today, enjoy the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival, the Dane County Farmer's Market, or live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out the Bike the Barns fundraiser at Badger Prairie County Park.
In our weekly police report, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired and a 19-year-old suspect was taken into custody.
Culver's of Verona is open today until 10:30 PM, though please note they are currently closed for a building remodel and are not serving the flavor of the day.
